title: Evaluation of the Sharing Polynomial
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, let $s\in F$, and let $q$ be a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$. For every $a\in F$, the polynomial $s+Xq(X)$ evaluates to $s+a q(a)$.
